strategyPoints: Tire degradation will be a major factor on this abrasive surface; managing the rubber will be key to a strong result.
The pit window is relatively short on this 3.219km layout, so timing the stops perfectly is crucial.
Fuel consumption is always a concern around Adelaide, balancing pace with economy is a delicate balancing act.
With limited overtaking opportunities, track position is king; a good start and a clean first lap are essential.
Safety cars are common on street circuits, so teams need to be prepared to react quickly to changing circumstances.
